overview_description.description:
Zerocrater is a platform for office catering and snacks that allows users to select from a number of food options and have them delivered to their workplace from eateries. The platform of the company provides catering meals to small and medium-sized enterprises and simplifies the ordering procedure, allowing clients to create a high-performing office culture by bringing employees together over food.

Zerocrater was established in 2009 in San Francisco, California by Arram Sabeti.

product.name: Corporate Catering
product.description: Managed office meal programs providing customized buffet and boxed meals for employees, including menu planning, dietary preference support, delivery, and onsite service.

product.name: Corporate Cafeterias
product.description: Managed workplace cafeteria programs with chef-led onsite dining, curated snacks, micro-kitchen amenities, and barista coffee services customized to an organization’s space and culture.

product.name: Event Catering
product.description: Managed catering for corporate events, with customizable buffet or boxed menus, onsite serving staff, catering equipment, setup, and themed decor.

product.name: CaterAI
product.description: An AI-assisted catering planning tool that generates customized event menus and can help arrange onsite staff, equipment, and decor based on event requirements.
